label: D-4 part-time work: waiting period before eligibility
unit: months after entry or status change
appliesTo: D-4-1 and D-4-7 holders wanting a part-time work permit
why: A student who budgets on part-time earnings from month one has budgeted on something that cannot legally happen yet. This is administrative guidance rather than statute, so it can move without a legislative change — which is exactly why it is worth watching.

history.source: Study in Korea — residence and stay information, part-time work
history.note: Counted from the date of entry or of the change of status, whichever applies.
